payload.reason: The evidence indicates that PARENT correlates better with human judgments compared to other metrics, particularly in the context of the WebNLG challenge and WikiBio settings.

claims.text: PARENT shows higher correlation with human judgments than other text generation metrics in the WebNLG challenge.
PARENT demonstrates the highest correlation with human evaluations across various settings, including divergent references in WikiBio.
PARENT is competitive or superior to existing metrics in terms of correlation with human ratings on grammaticality, fluency, and semantics.
